{{Quote|Get that thing out of my face, you little skug."<br />"This little skug is just doing what she's been told.|[[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Clone Wars 4">[[The Clone Wars 4|''The Clone Wars'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Skug''' was an insult used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Sand Blasted">{{Tales|4|Sand Blasted}}</ref>  It was especially popular among [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]].<ref name="Slaves of the Republic">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref> "Vench my skug" was an exclamation of surprise.<ref name="Nampi">''[[Jabba the Hutt: The Hunger of Princess Nampi]]''</ref>
